daily_wisdom: The biggest money in aggressive trading is made by those who cut losses without hesitation at their stop and hold winners without panic through normal volatility. Your stop loss is not a suggestion — it is a contract you make with yourself before you enter the trade, when your thinking is clear and unemotional. Honor that contract every single time.
